title: Single-Molecule methods to investigate mechanisms of transcription by RNA polymerase of Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
authors: Lin, Wenxia; Herrera-Asmat, Omar; Tong, Alexander B; Kong, Tiantian; Bustamante, Carlos
one_liner_zh: 该文用单分子FRET和光镊研究结核分枝杆菌RNA聚合酶转录机制，涉及蛋白-DNA动态互作，但以实验方法为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，与课题方法轴匹配度有限。
abstract: Single molecule methods have become prevalent tools in elucidating molecular processes across various life science fields over the past three decades, driving breakthroughs in understanding their underlying molecular mechanisms. In our study, we employed two single-molecule methods, Forster Resonance Energy Transfer (smFRET) and high-resolution optical tweezers, to investigate the transcription of Mycobacterium tuberculosis RNA polymerase (MtbRNAP) from initiation through to termination. We aim to provide a set of comprehensive biophysical tools to deepen our current understanding of MtbRNAP and its transcription factors. These experimental assays represent an important step towards unraveling the molecular dynamics and interactions that support transcription in Mycobacterium tuberculosis.
abstract_zh: 过去三十年间，单分子方法已成为生命科学各领域阐明分子过程的重要工具，推动了对其潜在分子机制理解的突破。在我们的研究中，我们采用了两种单分子方法，即福斯特共振能量转移（smFRET）和高分辨率光镊，来研究结核分枝杆菌RNA聚合酶（MtbRNAP）从起始到终止的转录过程。我们旨在提供一套全面的生物物理工具，以加深当前对MtbRNAP及其转录因子的理解。这些实验方法代表了揭示支持结核分枝杆菌转录的分子动力学和相互作用的重要一步。
